mechanism: Terbinafine is a CYP3A4 and CYP2D6 inhibitor that may increase cenobamate plasma concentrations, while cenobamate induces CYP3A4 and may reduce terbinafine efficacy.
action: Monitor cenobamate levels and clinical effects; consider dose adjustment if adverse effects emerge; verify terbinafine efficacy for fungal infection treatment.
